scope: Selected label warning references, not a complete label summary, trial exposure assessment, adverse-event analysis or clinical recommendation.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Revlimid / lenalidomide product label
source.note: The product label identifies Revlimid as a lenalidomide product.

boxed_warning.basis: The boxed section addresses embryo-fetal harm, blood count toxicity and venous/arterial thromboembolic events.

selected_warnings.basis: The label describes developmental harm and pregnancy-related precautions.
The label identifies substantial neutrophil and platelet reductions.
Venous and arterial events are described, including multiple-myeloma combination-treatment contexts.
Liver failure is described in patients receiving the dexamethasone combination.
The label describes severe skin syndromes, including potentially fatal reactions.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Velcade / bortezomib product label
source.note: The product label identifies Velcade as a bortezomib product.

boxed_warning.basis: No boxed-warning section is present in the verified SPL version.

selected_warnings.basis: The label describes sensory neuropathy, with severe sensory or motor cases also reported.
Low blood pressure is described, including postural and orthostatic presentations.
The label describes new or worsening heart failure and reduced ventricular function.
The label describes severe lung syndromes, including respiratory distress and infiltrative lung disease.
The label describes cyclical platelet and neutrophil reductions.

source.title: Darzalex / daratumumab product label
source.note: The product label identifies Darzalex as a daratumumab product.

boxed_warning.basis: No boxed-warning section is present in the verified SPL version.

selected_warnings.basis: The intravenous reference label describes serious infusion reactions, including anaphylactic reactions.
The label describes interference with antibody detection during blood compatibility testing.
The label describes serious infections, including life-threatening and fatal cases.
The label describes possible worsening of background-therapy-related neutrophil and platelet reductions.
The label describes fetal harm potential based on the mechanism of action.

source.note: The product label identifies Pomalyst as a pomalidomide product.

boxed_warning.basis: The boxed section addresses embryo-fetal harm and venous/arterial thromboembolic events.

The label describes severe skin syndromes, including potentially fatal reactions.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: HEMADY / dexamethasone product label
source.note: HEMADY identifies dexamethasone. This pinned historical reference does not establish the formulation or current marketing status of a trial intervention.

boxed_warning.basis: No boxed-warning section in this selected reference; this does not imply low risk.

selected_warnings.basis: Adrenal-axis suppression, hyperglycemia and Cushing’s syndrome are described.
Immunosuppression can worsen or reactivate infections.
Blood-pressure, fluid and electrolyte changes are described.
Venous and arterial thrombosis risk is described.
